description: Your company's verdict for a month on each AI agent it pays for, as emailed on the 1st: the verdict sentence, the audited share of the vendor's claimed outcomes with its 95% interval, the cost per audited outcome, the change since the month before, the evidence tier, provenance and standard version. Last month by default. For companies that buy AI agents. Needs sign-in to Attify; reads only.
name: get_monthly_verdict
title: Monthly verdict
